about: 1. Using Japanese characters such as Samurai and Ninja to knock down zombies that are also based on Japanese motifs, you can fully experience never-before-seen scenes and worldviews with a theme set in Edo Japan, which is totally unique in the genre!

2. The map is automatically generated and the amount of items and enemy placement are all random. Since the randomness increases as the stage progresses, you can challenge every dungeons in a different environment every time!

Due to the strong randomness of the situation, the amount and placement of enemies and the occurrence of special events at each level are often beyond the control of the player's own operating skills alone, making the player's judgment of the…

4. You can experience a different dungeon strategy every time you challenge a dungeon. You can fully enjoy your own way of playing with various secret techniques and items in a different situation from other players!
summary: Be ready to sweat your hands and brain, cuz it’s time for O-EDO-ZOMBIE!!
